rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something or someone that was previous or earlier.

example.english: My former colleague has now moved to Canada.
example.traditional: 我以前嘅同事而家搬咗去加拿大。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 ge3 tung4 si6 ji4 gaa1 bun1 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6

rows.note: Use this especially for a previous holder of an office or position, such as a former president or former boss.

example.english: My former boss treated me to lunch today.
example.traditional: 前任老闆今日請我食飯。
example.jyutping: cin4 jam6 lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6
